eligibilityReason: release build measured on a quiet host with the required run count

app.timeToInteractive.reason: AppShellUITests asserts a connected device row before its 2s budget, so the measurement needs a real device and the UI lane

artifact.open.blockedBy: a maintainer ruling on the zero-copy artifact path
artifact.open.designRow: I.2 row 6 (large artifact transfer, zero-copy leg)
artifact.open.reason: artifact.open does not exist; whether to build it is itself one of the decisions section I.3 expects SPK-1 to unblock, so it cannot be baselined before it is decided

artifact.pagedRead.blockedBy: artifact fixture generation in the perf lane
artifact.pagedRead.designRow: I.2 row 6 (large artifact transfer, paged base64 leg)
artifact.pagedRead.reason: measurable in principle through artifact.read, but a seeded Job's Artifacts total a few kilobytes and the 128 MiB and 1 GiB fixtures are built only by the Swift opt-in slow artifact tests, not by this harness

calibration.busyLoop.description: fixed CPU workload used as the ratio denominator
calibration.busyLoop.designRow: noise control (design section I.2, ratio-based PR gate)

daemon.busyResources.blockedBy: a harness leg that drives a Golden Journey loop on the isolated daemon
daemon.busyResources.reason: the resource window samples an idle daemon only; a busy footprint needs a Golden Journey loop driving the daemon, and this harness is read-only by construction and submits no operation

daemon.warmStartRecovery.description: spawn through verified clean replay marker and complete Job readback; includes verification

daemon.warmStartRecovery.history.description: spawn through complete terminal History readback and zero recovery markers; includes verification
daemon.warmStartRecovery.history.designRow: I.2 rows 2 and 7 (10k terminal History restart)

ipc.health.designRow: I.2 row 4 (IPC request p50/p95/p99, UDS leg)

ipc.jobList.designRow: I.2 row 4 (IPC request p50/p95/p99, UDS leg)

ipc.jobStatus.designRow: I.2 row 4 (IPC request p50/p95/p99, UDS leg)

ipc.namedPipe.blockedBy: a Windows performance capture with a named-pipe client
ipc.namedPipe.reason: the macOS capture uses Unix domain sockets and does not measure the Windows named-pipe transport

ipc.xpc.blockedBy: an absolute XPC measurement from a client the daemon accepts
ipc.xpc.reason: the XPC leg accepts only the signed App as its peer, and this harness is an unsigned Unix-domain-socket client; RuntimeXPCTransportCostTests publishes relative XPC cost only; the Rust daemon's XPC ingress is also opt-in (ARKDECK_APP_INGRESS=history)

job.cancelReconcile.blockedBy: a Rust harness leg that submits, cancels and reconciles a Job, and a device window
job.cancelReconcile.reason: the row times the cancellation of a running readOnly Job; this harness is read-only by construction and never submits the Job it would cancel, and the terminal leg needs an HDC child process on a real device; the Rust daemon supports job.reconcile, but this capture does not time a cancellation/reconciliation workload

job.eventsPage.blockedBy: a fixture that produces a 1,000-event Job
job.eventsPage.reason: job.events is published and read-only, but every seeded Job is an observe.device Job carrying a handful of events, not the 1,000-event Job the budget is written for; a page of a seeded Job would only budget its own scale

job.eventsWait.blockedBy: a registry, schema and client change that publishes job.events.wait
job.eventsWait.reason: job.events.wait is a proposal in design section F.2 and is not in the published single v1 method table; only the job.events pull page exists

job.journalAppend.blockedBy: a timed durable-append leg over a 1,000-event Job
job.journalAppend.reason: no leg times a durable journal append: this harness only reads, and the soak appends journals without timing them; the Swift per-event figure came from JournalRecoveryContractTests' opt-in journal benchmark, which times the Swift engine

package.size.blockedBy: TASK-XPA-022 (Windows packaging) and a macOS installer producer
package.size.designRow: I.2 row 12 (installer size and update delta)
package.size.reason: no DMG or MSIX producer exists in the repository, so there is no artefact to size

ui.frameResponse.reason: needs the UI lane on both platforms

viewer.scale.blockedBy: a maintainer ruling on wall-clock Viewer budgets, and the UI lane
viewer.scale.designRow: I.2 row 10 (Viewer build, search, hit-test, scroll)
viewer.scale.reason: build, search and hit-test are covered by the existing ratio gate in ViewerScalePerformanceTests, whose header refuses wall-clock budgets; the scroll leg needs the UI lane
